subject: integration
name: Payments standard (PAY_0_1)
summary: A definition of PAY_0_1: one group, request (risk 1), the per-site right to ask the person for a payment. Its one function exists because a module needs one: the definition says the browser registers no provider, so a call is unavailable and no handle is given. Payments go through orivon.pay, which needs a click or key press for each sheet and shows a sheet before anything is sent; that path is not judged here. The row has no code, provider, address or request. Level 4 with privacy as a definition. Judged here by its publisher.
